text:
You need someone who can tighten on-page tags and measurement so your pages are easier to find, better organized, and clearer to analyze.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and while my background is in data analysis and tracking, I’ve done the kind of structured work that supports strong SEO execution. In my Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; that led to 18% of ad budget reallocated and CAC down 12% the next quarter. In my GA4 migration and tracking plan, I built a tracking plan and GTM setup for the move from Universal Analytics to GA4; 46 events were mapped with no gap in year-on-year reporting.  

I can help with keyword-driven page structure, tag cleanup, and performance analysis using SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, and Power BI.
